notes.title: Optimization Open Test
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We tried to improve the animation optimization in the game, but on some systems it may cause crashes. Therefore, we ask for your help to test the stability of this version.

⚠️ DISCLAIMER: when switching to the branch, your saves may break. Save them in advance (AppData\LocalLow\OneMoreTime\Tavern Manager Simulator)

Here’s how to access it:
[list]
[*] Go to your Steam Library
[*] Right-click on Tavern Manager Simulator → Properties
[*] Go to the Betas tab
[*] Enter this code: svgdfrgWewgvWEsf
[*] Select the beta branch and let it update!
[/list]

What to do in the game:

1. Play for 30 minutes with the option disabled (disabled by default)
2. Launch the game three times and exit after a minute.
3. Enable the option at the end of the settings, play again
4. Fill out the survey (link on the screen in the menu)
5. Send an in-game report with the title "about optimization" and indicate whether there were any crashes.


Thank you so much!

notes.title: Big Update: Hotel is here!

We've been preparing for this moment for a long time and finally added a BIG construction site! Now your guests have a place to relax after a delicious lunch - meet the HOTEL! You will have to greet guests, clean the rooms and keep things cozy.

[list]

[/list]

Now you can adjust the prices of dishes!
More visitors or a calm atmosphere? Choose the balance that suits you.

If an item has fallen through the floor or is stuck after an upgrade, solve the problem right in the pause menu.

🧚 [b]Flexible customization of fairy waitresses[/b]
[list]
[*] Determine which halls they work in.
[*] Choose whether they will do cleaning.
[*] Set their priorities so that the work is more efficient!

[list]
[*] Visitors no longer get stuck near the toilet.
[*] Fairies now have cute wings and work magic while working.

notes.title: DevLog #4 Tavern Development
notes.content:
Tavern development is one of the key features in the game. You will feel how your Tavern grows bigger and better. Gain experience, earn gold, and buy new level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/d6ce12529998a84ceabc3fa6c4034711fdbd025a.png[/img]

[h2]Level 1[/h2]
A small, modest building. If you clean it up, you can put in a few tables.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/c3ec43eb4bce41e844078e5b1baaa9e9b6d8582d.png[/img]

[h2]Level 5[/h2]
Now we have a kitchen! You can cook hot soup and tasty meat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/1263e8cd0e948ef651641c2c6bdcead2cb368e66.png[/img]

[h2]Level 10[/h2]
Two floors! Now there's definitely enough space for everyone. Maybe we can even set up a stage for artists.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/de7a3587e29e6fbb907307d2fac0d63c507b09e2.png[/img]

[h2]Level 15[/h2]
Time to dance and listen to lively music! It would be great to have a summer terrace.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/f3a55cbe68560b199aa68d7e70dc7bff9da8d789.png[/img]

notes.title: DevLog #3 Systems
notes.content:
We strive to create interesting systems that can immerse you in the atmosphere of a real fantasy tavern. Let's look at some of them.

[b]Quality System[/b]
To serve food, you need to cook or prepare it first. You can make it excellent, ordinary, or bad. Customers will give you tips and reviews based on the quality of food in your tavern.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/048ab695f8686340a54b234c5f2f728e39a2125e.gif[/img]

[b]Сleanliness system[/b]
Some customers can leave dirty footprints and garbage. Well, you need to clean it or rich customers will not entry your Tavern.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/40b00c1c31a05f69b3826d3c90be7f6c5e62dcef.png[/img]

[b]Decoration System[/b]
You can purchase various decorations to make your tavern even cozier. Give it your own personal touch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/33186abcdd558684df8fe444a312d25f4e320479.gif[/img]

[b]Reputation System[/b]
Good food, a clean space, and a friendly smile will earn you 5-star ratings from customers. Gain reputation to unlock a new level. Each tavern level expands space, introduces new mechanics, and offers more opportunities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/d6ce12529998a84ceabc3fa6c4034711fdbd025a.png[/img]

[b]Add To Wishlist [/b]
Add to wishlist and follow to keep up with the game and support us.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/da8b1ca645f41cd6e8db23975ee738b39ef09715.gif[/img]

Have an interesting idea? Leve a comment!

notes.title: DevLog #2 Weather
notes.content:
[h3]Day and Night[/h3]
Now the game features a full day and night cycle. Lanterns light up at night, and you can even see the lights in the castle on the hill. Maybe there's a princess waiting for you there?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/8608c9133767a10fa677899d2a769c2f97029447.gif[/img]

[h3]Different Weather[/h3]
We have added various types of weather conditions. From rain to a meteor shower. No matter what the weather is like outside - the tavern awaits guests.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/70e8f26e4399ffe44ce60fd37f37ac32b80b6960.png[/img]

[h3]Add To Wishlist[/h3]
Add to wishlist and follow to stay up to date with the game and support us.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/da8b1ca645f41cd6e8db23975ee738b39ef09715.gif[/img]

notes.title: DevLog #1 - Let’s Cook
notes.content:
Welcome to our Tavern. We will be sharing updates on its development and the fun activities available.

What's a tavern without delicious food? Let's start with that!

[b]Beer[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/f252a07ad4949f2dd2f915ef8cb5b56f7c58955f.gif[/img]
Pouring beer for a customer is an art. Close the tap too early, and the customer will be unhappy; too late, and you'll spill precious beer on the floor.


[b]Snacks[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/300c2715b653a396acd7fc0ebafbc3056845c93b.gif[/img]
Good beer deserves good snacks. Now you can arrange them on the shelves.

[b]Hot Soup[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/ca1ab198311e1ce89744a9cf788903cb86949830.gif[/img]
You can cook delicious soups for travelers. Which way will you stir it?

[b]Juicy Steak[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/4cbb63c972b6cc5bfc503b9b9eb8558d843f1382.gif[/img]
Pound it well and sear it on both sides. Just be careful not to overcook it!

[b]Add to Wishlist[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/da8b1ca645f41cd6e8db23975ee738b39ef09715.gif[/img]
Add to your wishlist and follow to stay updated on the game and support us.

[b]Thank you for being here![/b]
